mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.25% (the zero lower bound) indicates an accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.25%, the S&P 500 produces negative or flat 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is above 0.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 6.0% and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 units, it signals a deteriorating labor market and weak housing demand, indicating an economic slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 6.0% and HOUST < 1000, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5.0% and industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105, it signals a late-cycle economic expansion where growth is slowing and inflationary pressures are building, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 5.0% and INDPRO > 105, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1000 units indicates strong residential demand, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion, supporting positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is above 1000, the S&P 500 produces negative or flat 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (the 2017 base), it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, indicating an economic slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 100, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1000 units and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) surpass 400,000 million dollars, it signals robust demand for housing and construction, supporting positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 400000, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An industrial production level above 100 (the 2017 base) indicates expanding manufacturing output, signaling economic growth that supports positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is above 100, the S&P 500 produces negative or flat 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances.
